purpose: one prospective expanded-development cycle after bounded feature-change failure; cal-01/cal-02 excluded
fitting: CE only; warm-start TCN and reuse its original training-only normalization; no augmentation or SupCon
sampling: 75% public / 25% local training mass; local classes equally weighted; random valid prefix budgets; whole sessions kept apart
selection: local observed-class macro-F1 averaged over 5/10/20/30 budgets; historical public clean-retention loss <=0.02 and no local-class recall regression; >=0.10 gain over base; select checkpoint on development only
simpler_model: prefer eligible forest within 0.01 local score if its measured CPU p50 is no worse
policy: new candidates always uncommitted until separate calibration; old confidence policy is not transferred
limits: Five original Instagram training connections supplemented by three varied new visits across two local dates. Fresh later selection sessions; no calibration/final input. Fixed two-family CE/summary-forest protocol, no extra feature sweep. If seed17 is ineligible stop; no automatic capture or default promotion.
